scripts.dev: node scripts/prepare-dev.mjs && cd backend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && cd ../frontend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && cd .. && concurrently "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd backend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm install && cd backend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('dist','../backend/dist/public',{recursive:true})"
